description: This Swift source file defines a class `CanvasSchemeHandler` that implements the `WKURLSchemeHandler` protocol. It manages custom URL scheme handling for a web view, serving local files from a specified root directory, handling special cases such as index files and security checks, and generating HTML responses for errors or scaffolding. It appears tailored for embedding or serving content within an app, likely for rendering or interactive purposes in a specific session context.

classes.name: CanvasSchemeHandler
classes.description: A class implementing a custom URL scheme handler for WKWebView, serving local files, handling errors, and generating responses.

methods.name: webView(_:start:)
methods.description: Starts loading the resource for the provided URL scheme task, serving the appropriate data or error response.

methods.name: webView(_:stop:)
methods.description: Stops loading of the URL scheme task (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: response(for:)
methods.description: Generates a response containing the MIME type and data for a given URL, handling session validation, file resolution, and error responses.

methods.name: resolveFileURL(sessionRoot:requestPath:)
methods.description: Resolves the file URL based on the requested path, handling directory indexing and fallback behaviors.

methods.name: resolveIndex(in:)
methods.description: Returns the index.html or index.htm file URL within a directory if it exists.

methods.name: isFileURL(_:withinDirectory:)
methods.description: Checks whether a file URL is within a specified directory, to enforce security boundary.

methods.name: html(_:title:)
methods.description: Creates a CanvasResponse with HTML content, wrapping the body in a styled HTML template.

methods.name: welcomePage(sessionRoot:)
methods.description: Generates a simple HTML page indicating Canvas is ready and instructing to create an index.html.

methods.name: scaffoldPage(sessionRoot:)
methods.description: Provides a scaffold page when no index.html is present, attempting to load a bundled template or falling back to the welcome page.

methods.name: loadBundledResourceData(relativePath:)
methods.description: Loads resource data bundled within the app given a relative path, ensuring safety against directory traversal.

methods.name: textEncodingName(forMimeType:)
methods.description: Determines the text encoding name based on MIME type, defaulting to utf-8 for text types.
